sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 3 Holders of Representative Offices Laws Suspention of Operation Order 2000
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 3 OF 2000
HOLDERS OF
REPRESENTATIVE OFFICES LAWS (SUSPENSION OF OPERATION) ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 3 OF 2000
An Order to provide for
suspension of operation of certain laws relating to the holders of
representative offices
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th February, 2000].
F.No.2-5/2000-Min. 1, dated 15th
February, 2000.--Whereas it is expedient to provide for suspension of operation
of certain laws relating to the holders of representative offices for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Holders of Representative
Offices Laws (Suspension of Operation) Order, 2000.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 12th October, 1999.

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 3 Holders of Representative Offices Laws Suspention of Operation Order 2000
sections.description:
Interpretation

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 3 OF 2000
HOLDERS OF
REPRESENTATIVE OFFICES LAWS (SUSPENSION OF OPERATION) ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 3 OF 2000
An Order to provide for
suspension of operation of certain laws relating to the holders of
representative offices
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th February, 2000].
F.No.2-5/2000-Min. 1, dated 15th
February, 2000.--Whereas it is expedient to provide for suspension of operation
of certain laws relating to the holders of representative offices for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
2. Interpretation.--For
the purpose of this Order "holder of ,representative office" means a
person who on the 12th day of October, 1999, was holding the office of a member
of the National Assembly, the Senate or a Provincial Assembly, the Chairman and
Deputy Chairman Senate, the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the National
Assembly, the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of a Provincial Assembly and includes
a person who on the said date was holding the office of a Parliamentary
Secretary and a Provincial Parliamentary Secretary.

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 3 Holders of Representative Offices Laws Suspention of Operation Order 2000
sections.description:
Suspension of operation of certain laws

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 3 OF 2000
HOLDERS OF
REPRESENTATIVE OFFICES LAWS (SUSPENSION OF OPERATION) ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 3 OF 2000
An Order to provide for
suspension of operation of certain laws relating to the holders of
representative offices
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th February, 2000].
F.No.2-5/2000-Min. 1, dated 15th
February, 2000.--Whereas it is expedient to provide for suspension of operation
of certain laws relating to the holders of representative offices for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
4. Suspension of operation of
certain laws.--The operation of------
(i) the Members of Parliament
(Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974 (XXVII of 1974);
(ii) the Chairman, Speaker
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXXXII of 1975);
(iii) the Deputy Chairman and
Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXXXIII of
1975);
(iv) the Balochistan Assembly
Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1975 (Balochistan Act No.II of 1975);
(v) the Balochistan Speaker's and
Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (Balochistan
Act No. V of 1975);
(vi) the Provincial Assembly of
North-Vest Frontier Province (Salaries and Allowances of the Members) Act, 1974
(N.-W.F.P. Act No.XI of 1974);
(vii) the North-West Frontier
Province Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
Act, 1975 (N.-W.F.P. Act No.III of 1975);
(viii) the Punjab Provincial
Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974 (Punjab Act
No.XVI of 1974);
(ix) the Punjab Provincial
Assembly Speaker (Salaries; Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (Punjab Act
No.XLII of 1975);
(x) the Punjab Provincial
Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (Punjab
Act No.XLIII of 1975);.
(xi) the Sindh Provincial
Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974 (Sindh Act No.XXVI of
1974);
(xii) the Sindh Speaker's and
Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (Sindh Act
No.VII of 1975), and
(xiii) any jaw, rule, order,
sanction or notification relating to terms and conditions of Federal
Parliamentary Secretaries and Provincial Parliamentary Secretaries, shall
remain suspended during the period the National Assembly, the Senate and the
Provincial Assemblies remain suspended and it is hereby declared for removal of
doubts that no salary, allowance, financial benefit, right, privilege or
concession shall accrue or be deemed to have ever accrued or become payable to
any holder of representative office for the period the National Assembly, the
Senate and Provincial Assemblies remain suspended, in pursuance of the
Proclamation of the fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the Provisional
Constitution Order No. l of 1999, as amended.
